The Opportunity

Tetra Tech is looking for full-time, Environmental Scientists to work out of our Rancho Cordova, CA or Oakland, CA offices.

Position Summary

The selected candidate will provide technical support in the areas of environmental site assessment, brownfields, site investigation, and remediation activities. Team members are also responsible for the planning and oversight of operations and site health and safety. The work involves environmental consulting and site investigation services.

Essential Job Functions

The following duties are considered essential to the role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions:

Multi-media sampling
Field audits and inspections
Organize and review data
Write and perform technical reviews of reports
Plan field investigations
Subcontractor oversight
Perform Phase I and Phase II Environmental Site Assessments
Brownfield assessments
Site inspections and/or site investigations on sites with potentially hazardous substances
Travel to lead and support environmental projects

Why Tetra Tech

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 60 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Your Impact

Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

Required Qualifications (Required)

BS degree in environmental sciences or physical sciences (e.g., geology, biology hydrology, toxicology, health physics).
2+ years of experience
Must have prior experience in the environmental industry with demonstrated experience with practical field experience performing multi-media sampling, including groundwater, soil, and soil gas

Preferred Qualifications

40-hour OSHA HAZWOPER training is a plus.
Experience supporting remedial design, feasibility studies, hazardous waste, site investigations, site remediation, field sampling, air quality, ecological restoration, radiological issues, and/or water resources a plus
Analytical skills related to qualitative and quantitative data
Strong technical and non-technical writing
Information and data analysis
Work on multiple projects teams simultaneously
Proficiency with MS Office applications is required

Well organized and strong attention to detail.
Able to multi-task
Highly motivated, customer focused and work well in a team environment across multiple communication platforms.
Excellent communication, responsiveness, and customer service skills.
Ability to manage a heavy workload.

Work outdoors in all weather conditions. Climate ranges from extremely dry to extremely wet and from hot to cold. Rain, snow, wind, or dust may be encountered.
Walk on uneven terrain. Terrain may be steep, uneven, rocky, and covered with vegetation.
Pack heavy equipment and perform excavations using hand tools.
Carry field equipment (35 to 40 pounds)
Don personal protective gear as needed
Drive on a regular basis.
Pass a motor vehicle record background check and maintain a valid driver’s license and safe driving record is required.

Work schedule: Monday - Friday
Some field work requires working evenings and weekends and includes overnight stays when traveling.
Work locations: Office work performed in our Rancho Cordova, CA or Oakland, CA office. Hybrid is available

Life at Tetra Tech

Comprehensive and market-competitive benefits.

Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.

Prowess Consulting is looking for a writer-analyst to work on a per-deliverable, freelance basis. Experience using data to strengthen marketing, sales, technical, or thought leadership content

Job Title: Data Analyst

Job Summary:

The University of Colorado (CU) Anschutz School of Medicine (SOM) Research Office, within the Dean’s Office, is seeking an experienced and skilled Data Analyst to lead data analysis, reporting, and visualization for Biomedical Research activities and Service Centers, and for Centers and Institutes in the School of Medicine. This position will report to the Research Office Manager.

In this role, the Data Analyst will serve as a subject-matter expert (SME) for the unit, analyze research-related financial and operational data, build dashboards, and support leadership in answering strategic questions. Strong analytical and visualization capabilities are critical. Cross-functional collaboration and communication skills are also important, as the Data Analyst will work closely with research leadership, finance, and IT teams to ensure data integrity and actionable insights.

Specific projects may include: Tracking research expenditures of faculty receiving SOM grant funding; tracking requests, expenditures, and future commitments of Centers and Institutes; building dashboards for visualization of activities of SOM research cores, Centers, or Institutes (with data related to finances, services requested, key outcomes, etc.); extracting departmental research and Center/Institute expenditure data for space utilization reporting; creating dashboards and reports of financial commitments of Research Affairs office to support faculty recruitment, retention, and re-investment, and of SOM to support Center and Institutes.

Analyze financial and operational data related to biomedical research, service center, and center/institute activities.

About Acrisure

Acrisure is a global fintech leader empowering millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. The Role

Acrisure's Growth & Placement Analytics team supporting the executive leadership of our North America Insurance business operates at the intersection of data and business strategy, translating complex data assets into decisions that drive revenue and operational performance. As a Strategic Data Analyst on the Growth & Placement analytics pod, you will work directly alongside a small, high-visibility team that serves Acrisure's most senior executive stakeholders — including members of the C-suite.

This is an analyst role first, but not a narrow one. You will be expected to go beyond what the data says and communicate what it means: surfacing critical nuances, articulating data limitations with precision, and connecting analytical findings to Acrisure's business priorities. Your outputs will range from executive-facing decks and written narratives to self-service dashboards, often in the same week.

Alongside your analytical work, you will also engage meaningfully with the technical layer beneath your insights. Acrisure is investing significantly in its data infrastructure, most visibly through the adoption of Palantir Foundry as our enterprise analytics and application platform — and you will be an active contributor to how the underlying data assets are shaped, modeled, and made trustworthy. You should be as comfortable extending a dbt model or a Palantir Ontology object as you are drafting an executive memo. If you view the boundary between analytics and analytics engineering as porous rather than fixed, you will thrive here.

This is a growth-stage role on a team that is still defining how it operates. You will have meaningful influence over how the function takes shape, and you will report closely enough to executive leadership that your work will be visible from day one.

How You'll Drive Impact

Translate complex, multi-source datasets into concise executive narratives that communicate not just findings but implications and data limitations — giving leadership the context to act with confidence.
Develop and maintain analytical deliverables including executive-facing presentations, insight memos, and self-service dashboards, calibrating the format to the audience and urgency of the question.
Write sophisticated queries against Palantir Foundry Ontology to extract, transform, and validate data from core operational tables and dbt models.
Contribute to the analytics engineering layer that underpins your work: extend dbt models where needed, help stand up new data pipelines, and shape how Palantir Foundry is used to surface insights across the team.
Partner with senior stakeholders, including the Chief Strategy Officer, Head of Revenue, and other executive leads to understand their data questions, pressure-test assumptions, and deliver analysis that earns trust.
Uphold data modeling best practices in the work you touch: clear documentation, version control via Git, incremental build strategies, and data quality validation.
Identify gaps and inconsistencies in data and proactively surface them rather than papering over them — intellectual honesty is a core expectation of this role.
Leverage AI tools (Claude, Palantir AI FDE, Gemini, and others) to accelerate both analytical and engineering work, while applying rigorous critical evaluation to any AI-generated output before it informs a business decision or ships to production.

4–6 years of professional experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a strategy-adjacent analytics role.
Strong command of SQL you are comfortable writing complex queries involving window functions, CTEs, and multi-table joins, and you can read and debug queries you didn't write.
Hands-on experience with dbt or Palantir for data modeling — you understand the mechanics of models, tests, documentation, and incremental materialization strategies — or equivalent data modeling experience in another modern data warehouse environment.
Comfort working with a modern cloud data warehouse.
A demonstrable ability to communicate analytical findings to non-technical executive audiences — in writing, in decks, and in conversation.
The intellectual honesty to say 'the data doesn't fully answer this question, and here's why' and to make that observation useful rather than deflating.
Experience with a BI or visualization tool (Tableau, Power BI).
A genuine interest in learning Palantir Foundry and the intellectual openness to develop deep expertise as part of your growth on the team.
Comfort operating in ambiguity with a small, fast-moving team where the scope of your role will evolve as the function matures.
A skeptic's relationship with AI tools — you use them, you benefit from them, but you verify their outputs rather than accepting them at face value.
A bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical field, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice to Have

Direct experience with Palantir Foundry, even tangential exposure is valued.
Python proficiency, particularly for data transformation, pipeline orchestration, or scripting.
Exposure to insurance, financial services, or other complex B2B commercial environments.
Prior experience presenting findings directly to senior leadership audiences.

jobs.description:
Analyzes data, assesses trends and develops actionable insights and recommendations in support of enterprise-wide strategic business initiatives. Develops the analytics community at Vanguard by coaching others internally and participating in external events.

Role Summary

At Vanguard, we are advancing how data informs decision-making by developing deeper insight into how business actions drive client and operational outcomes. This role sits at the intersection of advanced analytics, product development, and business strategy, helping the organization move beyond describing what happened to understanding why it happened and what to do next .

As a Data Scientist, you will serve as a builder and architect of a decision product that integrates causal analysis, predictive modeling, and optimization to support high-impact business decisions. You will design the analytical engine that powers this product—defining how relationships are modeled, how uncertainty is quantified, and how outputs are generated for decision-making.

This role is well suited for someone who is technically rigorous, intellectually curious, and motivated by building analytical systems that operate in real-world environments.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop the analytical engine that underpins a decision product, including how relationships are modeled and outputs are generated
Apply causal inference techniques across both experimental and non-experimental settings, including situations where randomized testing is not feasible, practical, or cost-effective

Translate complex business questions into structured analytical frameworks and scalable solutions
Build production-quality analytical components that integrate into decision systems and can be deployed in partnership with engineering teams
Ensure model outputs are robust, interpretable, and appropriately reflect uncertainty and underlying assumptions
Partner cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to align the analytical engine with user needs and decision workflows
Continuously evaluate and improve modeling approaches to ensure accuracy, reliability, and business impact

Qualifications

Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field such as statistics, economics, mathematics, data science, operations research, or a related discipline; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
5+ years experience applying advanced analytical techniques, including causal inference, predictive modeling, and/or optimization
5+ years experience using quasi-experimental or observational methods to evaluate business interventions in real-world settings
Proficiency in Python, R, or similar tools, with the ability to write clean, scalable, and production-ready code
Strong understanding of statistical modeling, inference, and data analysis
Ability to design analytical frameworks that support decision-making under uncertainty
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional and ambiguous environments

About Acrisure

Acrisure is a global fintech leader empowering millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human expertise together, we connect clients with customized solutions across insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services, and more. In the last twelve years, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to almost $5 billion and employs over 19,000 colleagues in more than 20 countries.

The Role

Acrisure's Growth & Placement Analytics team supporting the executive leadership of our North America Insurance business operates at the intersection of data and business strategy, translating complex data assets into decisions that drive revenue and operational performance. As a Strategic Data Analyst on the Growth & Placement analytics pod, you will work directly alongside a small, high-visibility team that serves Acrisure's most senior executive stakeholders — including members of the C-suite.

This is an analyst role first, but not a narrow one. You will be expected to go beyond what the data says and communicate what it means: surfacing critical nuances, articulating data limitations with precision, and connecting analytical findings to Acrisure's business priorities. Your outputs will range from executive-facing decks and written narratives to self-service dashboards, often in the same week.

Alongside your analytical work, you will also engage meaningfully with the technical layer beneath your insights. Acrisure is investing significantly in its data infrastructure, most visibly through the adoption of Palantir Foundry as our enterprise analytics and application platform — and you will be an active contributor to how the underlying data assets are shaped, modeled, and made trustworthy. You should be as comfortable extending a dbt model or a Palantir Ontology object as you are drafting an executive memo. If you view the boundary between analytics and analytics engineering as porous rather than fixed, you will thrive here.

This is a growth-stage role on a team that is still defining how it operates. You will have meaningful influence over how the function takes shape, and you will report closely enough to executive leadership that your work will be visible from day one.

How You'll Drive Impact

Translate complex, multi-source datasets into concise executive narratives that communicate not just findings but implications and data limitations — giving leadership the context to act with confidence.
Develop and maintain analytical deliverables including executive-facing presentations, insight memos, and self-service dashboards, calibrating the format to the audience and urgency of the question.
Write sophisticated queries against Palantir Foundry Ontology to extract, transform, and validate data from core operational tables and dbt models.
Contribute to the analytics engineering layer that underpins your work: extend dbt models where needed, help stand up new data pipelines, and shape how Palantir Foundry is used to surface insights across the team.
Partner with senior stakeholders, including the Chief Strategy Officer, Head of Revenue, and other executive leads to understand their data questions, pressure-test assumptions, and deliver analysis that earns trust.
Uphold data modeling best practices in the work you touch: clear documentation, version control via Git, incremental build strategies, and data quality validation.
Identify gaps and inconsistencies in data and proactively surface them rather than papering over them — intellectual honesty is a core expectation of this role.
Leverage AI tools (Claude, Palantir AI FDE, Gemini, and others) to accelerate both analytical and engineering work, while applying rigorous critical evaluation to any AI-generated output before it informs a business decision or ships to production.

4–6 years of professional experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a strategy-adjacent analytics role.

Comfort working with a modern cloud data warehouse.
A demonstrable ability to communicate analytical findings to non-technical executive audiences — in writing, in decks, and in conversation.
The intellectual honesty to say 'the data doesn't fully answer this question, and here's why' and to make that observation useful rather than deflating.
Experience with a BI or visualization tool (Tableau, Power BI).
A genuine interest in learning Palantir Foundry and the intellectual openness to develop deep expertise as part of your growth on the team.
Comfort operating in ambiguity with a small, fast-moving team where the scope of your role will evolve as the function matures.
A skeptic's relationship with AI tools — you use them, you benefit from them, but you verify their outputs rather than accepting them at face value.
A bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical field, or equivalent professional experience.

Python proficiency, particularly for data transformation, pipeline orchestration, or scripting.

new_jobs.description:
Analyzes data, assesses trends and develops actionable insights and recommendations in support of enterprise-wide strategic business initiatives. Develops the analytics community at Vanguard by coaching others internally and participating in external events.

Role Summary

At Vanguard, we are advancing how data informs decision-making by developing deeper insight into how business actions drive client and operational outcomes. This role sits at the intersection of advanced analytics, product development, and business strategy, helping the organization move beyond describing what happened to understanding why it happened and what to do next .

As a Data Scientist, you will serve as a builder and architect of a decision product that integrates causal analysis, predictive modeling, and optimization to support high-impact business decisions. You will design the analytical engine that powers this product—defining how relationships are modeled, how uncertainty is quantified, and how outputs are generated for decision-making.

This role is well suited for someone who is technically rigorous, intellectually curious, and motivated by building analytical systems that operate in real-world environments.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop the analytical engine that underpins a decision product, including how relationships are modeled and outputs are generated
Apply causal inference techniques across both experimental and non-experimental settings, including situations where randomized testing is not feasible, practical, or cost-effective
Leverage predictive modeling and optimization approaches to support decision-making and scenario analysis
Translate complex business questions into structured analytical frameworks and scalable solutions
Build production-quality analytical components that integrate into decision systems and can be deployed in partnership with engineering teams
Ensure model outputs are robust, interpretable, and appropriately reflect uncertainty and underlying assumptions
Partner cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to align the analytical engine with user needs and decision workflows
Continuously evaluate and improve modeling approaches to ensure accuracy, reliability, and business impact

Qualifications

Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field such as statistics, economics, mathematics, data science, operations research, or a related discipline; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
5+ years experience applying advanced analytical techniques, including causal inference, predictive modeling, and/or optimization
5+ years experience using quasi-experimental or observational methods to evaluate business interventions in real-world settings
Proficiency in Python, R, or similar tools, with the ability to write clean, scalable, and production-ready code
Strong understanding of statistical modeling, inference, and data analysis
Ability to design analytical frameworks that support decision-making under uncertainty
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional and ambiguous environments
